    {"i": 30, "speaker": "bot", "text": "semi-automatic, fully automatic या कुछ और?"},

    {"i": 32, "speaker": "bot", "text": "ठीक है।"},
    {"i": 33, "speaker": "bot", "text": "अब बताइए machine में कितने cavities चाहिए जैसे दो cavity, चार cavity या कुछ और?"},
    {"i": 34, "speaker": "caller", "text": "English में ही है."},
    {"i": 35, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Okay, you want to continue in English?"},
    {"i": 36, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Please tell how many cavities do you need in the machine like two cavity, four cavity or something else."},
    {"i": 37, "speaker": "bot", "text": "You want to continue in English?"},
    {"i": 38, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Now please tell me how many cavities you need in the machine, two cavity, four cavity or something."},
    {"i": 39, "speaker": "caller", "text": "to continue नहीं है।"},
    {"i": 40, "speaker": "caller", "text": "हाँ।"},
    {"i": 41, "speaker": "caller", "text": "कैविटी।"},
    {"i": 42, "speaker": "caller", "text": "తెలుగు తెలుగు మాట్లాడండి madam ఎవరైనా ఉంటే తెలుగు తెలుగు మాట్లాడండి madam తెలుగు మాట్లాడండి."},
    {"i": 43, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Sorry, I can assist only in Hindi or English."},
    {"i": 44, "speaker": "bot", "text": "If you want."},
    {"i": 45, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Telugu में बात कर रहा है, वो लोग हैं."},
    {"i": 46, "speaker": "bot", "text": "मुझे माफ़ कीजिए मैं सिर्फ हिंदी या English में ही बात कर सकती हूँ."},
    {"i": 47, "speaker": "bot", "text": "अगर आपको किसी product की जानकारी चाहिए तो बताइए वरना call बंद कर दूँ."},
    {"i": 48, "speaker": "caller", "text": "नहीं।"},
    {"i": 49, "speaker": "caller", "text": "कितना मतलब?"},
    {"i": 50, "speaker": "bot", "text": "माफ़ कीजिए आपकी बात समझ नहीं आई."},
    {"i": 51, "speaker": "bot", "text": "क्या आप किसी product की जानकारी लेना चाहते हैं या call बंद कर दूं?"},
    {"i": 52, "speaker": "caller", "text": "हाँ।"},
    {"i": 53, "speaker": "bot", "text": "समझ गई आप Tirupati से बोल रहे हैं?"},
    {"i": 54, "speaker": "bot", "text": "अब आपको seller details WhatsApp पर भेज दूंगी जिनसे आप details और price discuss कर सकते हैं।"}
  ]
